Package com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl

Class FrozenPropertyWrapper

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.AbstractFrozenItem<javax.jcr.Property>
      • com.composum.sling.platform.staging.impl.FrozenPropertyWrapper
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    javax.jcr.Item, javax.jcr.Property
    public class FrozenPropertyWrapper
extends AbstractFrozenItem<javax.jcr.Property>
implements javax.jcr.Property
    (Not quite complete) wrapper for Property that disables writing. That's neccesary since some functions rely on adaptability to Property.

    Methods that are difficult / errorprone to implement and are likely not needed throw an UnsupportedRepositoryOperationException. We'd rather throw an exception than return a wrong value. If that occurs somewhere please complain, and it'll be done.
